component.name: nx-edit
component.summary: Edit the presets of a Line 6 HX Stomp

description.p: nx-edit is a native editor for the Line 6 HX Stomp. It speaks the pedal's USB protocol directly, as Line 6 offers no HX Edit for Linux.

ul.li: Reads the current preset from the pedal and draws its signal chain, including path B splits and joins
Turns knobs, picks list values, switches blocks on and off and changes snapshots on the pedal
Saves edits in the preset's own place on the pedal
Keeps a library of .hlx preset files that can be edited offline
Browses CustomTone, signs in to line6.com and downloads tones into the library

description.p: Block and parameter names come from HX Edit's own model data, which nx-edit does not ship. It is imported once from the official HX Edit installer or an installed HX Edit.
nx-edit is not affiliated with or endorsed by Line 6 or Yamaha. HX Stomp, HX Edit and CustomTone are their trademarks.
